title: Orders.Driver Name disagrees with Drivers master for the same Driver ID
decision: Drivers master is authoritative; Orders.driver_name dropped (denormalised copy was unreliable)
detail: Every Driver ID carries exactly one name in Orders, but it differs from the master name for all IDs.

title: Duplicate driver names in Drivers (different IDs)
decision: names are never used as keys; always join on driver_id

title: Same vehicle model appears under several vehicle types
decision: vehicle_type (operational class from Orders) moved to Vehicles dim next to vehicle_model; both kept, conflict documented
detail: Models affected: Chevrolet Express, Ford Transit, Freightliner M2, International DuraStar, Mercedes Sprinter, Ram ProMaster

title: Vehicles never used in any order
Drivers/vehicles working for more than one hub
Cancelled orders flagged Is Delayed=True
decision: is_delayed recomputed: delay only applies to Delivered orders

title: Cancelled orders carrying CSAT=1 placeholder
decision: csat_score set to NULL for cancelled orders (no survey exists)

title: Delivery date != order date + floor((processing+delivery hours)/24)
decision: hours are treated as the authoritative duration; Step 03 builds timestamps so dates reconcile wherever feasible

title: Order served by a vehicle before its purchase date
decision: kept; flagged as `vehicle_before_purchase`. Dim dates treated as registry dates, not in-service dates

title: Order served by a driver before hire date
Orders served by vehicles whose *current* status is 'Maintenance'
decision: Vehicle Status is a point-in-time snapshot, not history; never used as a historical filter

title: Missing delivery hours on delivered orders
Hub Capacity unit undocumented
decision: assumed orders/month (ADR-0003). Mean monthly utilisation: hub 1: 122%, hub 2: 75%, hub 3: 77%, hub 4: 78%, hub 5: 75%, hub 6: 76%

title: Delay reasons are near-uniformly distributed
decision: No action. Expect weak predictive signal; modelling step must report this honestly
detail: chi-square uniformity p=0.668; share range 9.3%-10.5%. Delay rate vs hub: chi-square p=0.199
